title: Run fresh no-FP Quartus synthesis, fitter, STA and physical invariants for the logical-immediate repair

scope: Build a fresh task-owned Quartus project from profile 2a1cd5c5 and the frozen 2011-byte boot image. resource: Every GamePC action holds resource-lock gamepc. One Quartus process at a time; max processors 16 on the 24-thread host, minimum free physical memory 8192 MiB, exclusive lock means no separate 16 GiB cap. Use task-local paths and event-driven monitoring with waits up to one hour.
